# Cross-implementation wire fixture for the tunnel frame protocol.
#
# Each line is `<name> <hex>` where <hex> is the postcard encoding of a known
# Frame value, produced by the SEPARATE relay repo's encoder
# (minutist-relay/crates/mcp-relay/src/tunnel/frame.rs, postcard
# default-features=false + alloc). The frame_protocol unit test re-encodes the
# same values with this crate's re-implemented Frame enum and asserts the bytes
# are byte-for-byte identical, AND decodes each line back into the expected
# value. This is the byte-level pin that proves the app-side client and the
# relay agree on the wire format (variant order = discriminant index = contract).
#
# To regenerate after a PROTOCOL_VERSION bump: build a throwaway
# `cargo run --example` in the relay repo encoding the same value set and paste
# the hex here. Do NOT hand-edit individual bytes.
#
# Frame values encoded (must match the unit test's `fixture_frames()`):
hello 00010a6465762d736563726574077375622d313233
hello_ack 01077375622d313233
hello_err_auth 0200
hello_err_ver 0201
ping 032a
pong 042a
request 050704504f5354042f6d6370020661636365707411746578742f6576656e742d73747265616d0c636f6e74656e742d74797065106170706c69636174696f6e2f6a736f6e2e7b226a736f6e727063223a22322e30222c226d6574686f64223a22746f6f6c732f6c697374222c226964223a317d
request_empty 050803474554042f6d63700000
response_start 0607c801020661636365707411746578742f6576656e742d73747265616d0c636f6e74656e742d74797065106170706c69636174696f6e2f6a736f6e
response_chunk 0707196576656e743a206d6573736167650a646174613a207b7d0a0a
response_end 0807
response_error 09071b6c6f6f706261636b20636f6e6e656374696f6e2072656675736564
